components.title: Polars / DuckDB / Arrow · 表格与数据
NiBabel / pydicom · 医学图像数据
GeoPandas / Rasterio / xarray · 地理与遥感
tmm / miepython · 薄膜与颗粒散射
LaTeX · 论文编译
components.instructions: Reuse an existing TeX toolchain, or prepare TinyTeX with the compilers, bibliography tools and fonts for the included templates. Templates can be obtained separately.

components.title: R · 统计计算
components.instructions: Install R from CRAN or connect an existing Rscript executable; use renv within research projects when needed.

components.title: Julia · 科学计算
components.instructions: Install Julia using its upstream installer or connect an existing executable; select the project with --project.

components.title: ngspice · 电路模拟
components.instructions: Install ngspice for the execution host, then bind the executable. Circuit netlists use its native syntax.

components.title: Optics-Photonics-AI-Lab
components.instructions: Import and activate the upstream plugin in the host. Use its prepare/bind operations for scientific solvers; existing OPTICS_HOME remains authoritative.

components.title: IOP · 实验平台
components.instructions: Follow the upstream connection guide and select the existing instrument host. Preserve its device connections and experiment state.

components.title: Crossref · 文献元数据
components.instructions: Use the existing host HTTP or literature connector, or the included httpx example. Crossref metadata is publicly accessible.

components.title: SQLAlchemy / psycopg · 数据库客户端
PostgreSQL · 研究数据库连接
components.instructions: Select an existing database connection in the host. Keep account credentials in its connection settings; use the prepared SQLAlchemy or psycopg client.

components.title: prysm
components.instructions: prysm 0.21.1 imports pkg_resources; use a compatible setuptools environment, or a newer upstream release that removes this dependency.

components.title: Perceval
components.instructions: drawsvg 2.4.1 and later fail to import with Perceval 1.3.1, so the recipe keeps an earlier drawsvg.

components.title: pyDHM
components.instructions: pyDHM 1.0.5 angularSpectrum uses np.exp2(i*pi*z*kz) instead of exp(i*2*pi*z*kz), so its propagation phase differs from the angular-spectrum operator. Use a corrected upstream implementation or a separately checked propagation program. Other pyDHM modules can be bound through an existing environment.

components.title: Meep / MPB
components.instructions: Prepare pymeep through an existing conda-family manager on Linux/WSL or macOS, or connect an existing Meep Python. The unrelated PyPI package named meep is not this solver.

components.title: Raysect
components.instructions: Raysect publishes wheels for Linux x86-64 only; elsewhere pip compiles it, which needs a C compiler and Cython.

components.title: SMUTHI
components.instructions: pip install smuthi compiles Fortran code and needs gfortran; there is no conda-forge build.

components.title: Finesse 3
components.instructions: Finesse 3.0.2 imports IPython and publishes wheels for Linux x86-64 and macOS arm64; elsewhere pip compiles it from source.

components.title: PtyPy
components.instructions: PtyPy is installed from its GitHub repository at a fixed commit; it is not on PyPI. MPI and GPU engines need their own libraries.

components.title: Strawberry Fields
components.instructions: Prepare the upstream compatible Python environment, then bind it. Choose any TensorFlow backend separately; this module does not download a GPU runtime.

components.title: MCX
components.instructions: Prepare MCX and the supported CUDA/OpenCL device runtime on the execution host; bind its Python interface pmcx. Installing an interface alone does not provide a GPU.

components.title: PyTorch
components.instructions: Choose the upstream CPU/CUDA/ROCm build for the execution host, or connect its existing PyTorch interpreter. Weights and training datasets are separate selections.

components.title: JAX
components.instructions: Prepare the upstream CPU/GPU/TPU build on the chosen execution host, then bind its Python. Accelerator plugins are selected for that host.

components.title: laserfun
components.instructions: laserfun is installed from its GitHub repository at a fixed commit; it is not on PyPI.

components.title: py-fmas
components.instructions: py-fmas is installed from its GitHub repository at a fixed commit; it is not on PyPI.

components.title: DEVSIM
components.instructions: DEVSIM needs BLAS/LAPACK. On x86-64 Linux/Windows this recipe includes Intel MKL, a substantial native dependency. macOS uses system math libraries; ARM Linux needs a supported system BLAS. Connect an existing solver environment to reuse its math libraries.

components.title: ADDA
components.instructions: Install the upstream serial/MPI build for the chosen host, or connect an existing executable.

components.title: RefractiveIndex.INFO
components.instructions: Select the required material records from the upstream YAML database or connect a local copy. This selection does not download the entire database.

components.title: SageMath
components.instructions: Prepare with an existing conda-family manager or connect a SageMath Python. Use Linux/WSL or macOS.

components.title: Transformers / PyTorch
components.instructions: Select the CPU/CUDA backend on the execution host, install transformers in that environment, and bind its Python. Model weights are selected separately.

components.title: PyTorch Geometric
components.instructions: Install PyTorch and the matching PyG extensions on the chosen host, then bind its Python. CUDA extensions must match the existing PyTorch build.

components.title: Faiss CPU
components.instructions: Prepare the CPU library with conda-forge or bind an existing Faiss interpreter. GPU builds are a separate host choice.

components.title: HOOMD-blue
components.instructions: Prepare the CPU build or connect an existing GPU build. The simulation specifies its device explicitly.

components.title: FEniCSx
components.instructions: Prepare DOLFINx and its MPI/PETSc libraries together or connect an existing interpreter. Use Linux/WSL or macOS.

components.title: ROOT
components.instructions: Connect PyROOT from a complete ROOT installation; its Python must match the ROOT build.

components.title: Phonopy
components.instructions: Prepare through conda-forge or connect an existing Phonopy interpreter. Force constants still come from the chosen force calculator.

components.title: PyRadiomics
components.instructions: Connect a PyRadiomics environment with its compiled image feature extensions and supported NumPy. Image and mask inputs are supplied by the project.

components.title: MONAI / PyTorch
components.instructions: Choose the host PyTorch CPU/CUDA backend, install MONAI there, and connect that interpreter. Select model weights and datasets separately.

components.title: OpenFF Toolkit
components.instructions: Prepare OpenFF Toolkit with RDKit through conda-forge or bind an existing interpreter. AmberTools charge methods and their platform support require a separate choice.

components.title: Gmsh Python
components.instructions: Prepare Gmsh and its native libraries with conda-forge or bind an existing Python. Headless Linux needs the native libraries even without opening a window.

components.title: PyEPICS
components.instructions: Connect Python with PyEPICS and the EPICS Channel Access library. Resolve the laboratory network and process variable names through the host connection settings.

components.title: LAMMPS
components.instructions: Connect a LAMMPS executable built with the interaction styles needed by the selected potential. Choose MPI/GPU builds on the execution host.

components.title: Quantum ESPRESSO
components.instructions: Connect pw.x on Linux/WSL or macOS. Pseudopotentials and the MPI launcher belong to the chosen calculation.

components.title: MuMax3
components.instructions: Connect MuMax3 on a Linux execution host with a supported NVIDIA GPU and driver.

components.title: minimap2
components.instructions: Connect minimap2 on Linux/WSL or macOS. Download only the reference assembly required for the selected analysis.

components.title: fastp
components.instructions: Connect fastp on Linux/WSL or macOS; preserve paired-read order when writing filtered FASTQ files.

components.title: AutoDock Vina
components.instructions: Connect the official Vina executable. Installing the Vina Python bindings alone does not install this command.

components.title: OpenFOAM
components.instructions: Connect a configured OpenFOAM runtime on Linux/WSL. Its library paths and solver modules must be available in the host process.

components.title: Icarus Verilog
components.instructions: Connect Icarus Verilog and the accompanying vvp executable. Compile HDL sources, then run the resulting simulation with vvp.

components.title: KiCad
components.instructions: Connect kicad-cli from a KiCad installation. Project symbol and footprint libraries remain explicit project inputs.

components.title: PHREEQC
components.instructions: Connect the PHREEQC executable and select the thermodynamic database used by the model.

components.title: FFmpeg
components.instructions: Connect an FFmpeg build with the codecs needed by the experiment. Input and output media stay in the research project.

components.title: MLflow tracking
components.instructions: Connect the project tracking service through the host. Starting a server or connecting an account is separate from selecting this module.

components.title: PubChem PUG REST
components.instructions: Query specific compound identifiers and selected properties; cache responses in the project. Do not download the complete database by default.

components.title: RCSB PDB
components.instructions: Retrieve selected structure identifiers and assemblies. Preserve mmCIF identifiers and the biological assembly selection.

components.title: PhysioNet
components.instructions: Choose a specific dataset. Use the host account connection if that dataset requires access; selection does not grant access or download records.

components.title: FRED / ALFRED
components.instructions: Connect the API key through the host. Select series and vintage dates explicitly; credentials do not belong in module files.

components.title: PyMeasure
components.instructions: Prepare the Python driver API. Select a supported instrument class and an existing VISA or serial backend; vendor libraries and device connections remain separate.

components.title: QCoDeS
components.instructions: Use an existing instrument driver and a project-local measurement database. Device connections belong to the laboratory host.

components.title: pylablib
components.instructions: Install the driver API; a particular camera or motion controller may also need its vendor SDK, USB driver and matching OS/architecture.

components.title: openDAQ
components.instructions: Use a compatible Python wheel on Linux or Windows. Select a real device connection string and its module, or explicitly select the reference-device simulator.

components.title: python-can
components.instructions: Physical CAN needs an OS-supported adapter driver, channel and bus configuration. The virtual interface is available without hardware.

components.title: MicroPython mpremote
components.instructions: Prepare the host client. The selected board must already run compatible MicroPython firmware; installing mpremote does not flash the board.

components.title: Lab Streaming Layer · 同步数据流
components.instructions: Supported wheels include liblsl. On other platforms install the matching upstream native library or bind an existing working interpreter. Device applications publish the actual streams.

components.title: ARTIQ
components.instructions: Connect artiq_run from the experiment host. Use the upstream Nix installation on Linux or MSYS2 on Windows, matching the core-device gateware. Keep device_db.py in the project.

components.title: labscript suite
components.instructions: Prepare an upstream labscript-suite environment with its Qt binding and apparatus profile, then bind its Python. BLACS, the connection table and device drivers are configured for the actual apparatus.

components.title: ROS 2
components.instructions: Connect ros2 from an already activated ROS 2 workspace on the robot host. Use the distribution installation instructions for that OS. The worker must retain the ROS setup environment; a bare executable path does not activate it.

components.title: MuJoCo
components.instructions: CPU simulation uses the native MuJoCo Python API without a viewer. Rendering backends and robot assets are selected separately.

components.title: Pycro-Manager
components.instructions: Prepare the Python client. Connect an existing Micro-Manager installation with its device adapters and saved hardware configuration; the desktop bridge normally uses port 4827.

components.title: PyLabRobot
components.instructions: Prepare the core protocol and resource model. Choose only the backend extras needed for the selected machine (for example usb or serial), plus its OS driver. The core also supports a hardware-free chatterbox backend.

components.title: Alicat flow controller driver
components.instructions: Select the physical serial endpoint and controller address. Read its configured gas and flow units; do not assume the numeric values use a universal flow unit.

components.title: sigrok-cli
components.instructions: Connect the upstream sigrok-cli executable and the acquisition device driver for this OS. PulseView is an optional viewer; it is not needed to read saved captures.

components.title: SoapySDR
components.instructions: Bind a Python environment with the upstream native SoapySDR library and the plugin for the selected radio. Installing the common API alone does not install every radio driver.

components.title: Laboratory device connections · 实验设备连接
components.instructions: Resolve named devices on the selected laboratory host using its existing device manager, IOP or upstream driver. Each device needs its own driver, address and operating configuration. This shared description is not a device instance; SeedEnv neither opens devices nor declares them connected. Reuse host connections that already exist.

modules.summary_en: Formulate and solve mathematical optimization problems.

modules.title: Image processing · 图像处理
modules.summary: 图像读写、滤波、分割与定量分析。
modules.summary_en: Read, filter, segment and quantify images.

modules.title: Finite elements · 有限元基础
modules.summary: 网格、弱形式、边界条件与 PDE 求解。
modules.summary_en: Build meshes and solve PDEs through finite-element weak forms.

modules.title: Parametric geometry · 参数化几何
modules.summary: 用程序构建几何并导出 STEP/STL。
modules.summary_en: Construct parametric geometry and export STEP or STL files.

modules.title: Quantum dynamics · 量子动力学
modules.summary: 量子态、算符与开放系统动力学。
modules.summary_en: Construct quantum states and operators, and solve open-system dynamics.

modules.title: Astronomy · 天文计算
modules.summary: 物理单位、坐标、时间与天文数据格式。
modules.summary_en: Work with astronomical units, coordinates, time and data formats.

modules.title: Instrument connections · 仪器连接
modules.summary: 通过已有 VISA 后端连接仪器。
modules.summary_en: Connect instruments through an existing VISA backend.

modules.title: Graphs and networks · 图与网络
modules.summary: 关系数据、图算法与网络模型。
modules.summary_en: Represent relations as graphs and apply network algorithms.

modules.title: Research writing · 研究写作
modules.summary: LaTeX 论文编译与文献引用。
modules.summary_en: Compile LaTeX papers and bibliographies using a prepared TeX installation.

modules.title: R statistics · R 统计计算
modules.summary: 连接已有 R 并运行研究脚本。
modules.summary_en: Connect an existing R installation and run research scripts.

modules.title: Julia science · Julia 科学计算
modules.summary: 连接 Julia 与项目环境。
modules.summary_en: Connect Julia and its project environments.

modules.title: Circuit simulation · 电路模拟
modules.summary: 连接 ngspice，运行原生电路网表。
modules.summary_en: Run native circuit netlists with an existing ngspice installation.

modules.title: Optics–Photonics AI Lab · 光学专业环境
modules.summary: 接入已有光学模型、求解器与研究程序。
modules.summary_en: Connect the specialist Optics-Photonics-AI-Lab environment.

modules.title: IOP laboratory · 实验平台
modules.summary: 连接已有 IOP 仪器与实验服务。
modules.summary_en: Connect an existing IOP instrument and experiment service.

modules.title: Literature metadata · 文献元数据
modules.summary: 检索 DOI 与文献元数据，连接原文和参考文献。
modules.summary_en: Find DOI and literature metadata through Crossref.

modules.title: Research databases · 研究数据库
modules.summary: SQL 查询、数据库客户端和已有研究数据连接。
modules.summary_en: Query research data with SQL clients and an existing database connection.

modules.title: Thin-film and sphere tools · 薄膜与球形散射工具
modules.summary: 多层膜与球形颗粒散射的计算起点。
modules.summary_en: The earlier combined thin-film and sphere-scattering software selection.

modules.title: Paraxial systems · 近轴光路
modules.summary: ABCD 矩阵、孔径、视场与高斯光束的近轴分析。
modules.summary_en: Analyze ABCD systems, apertures, fields of view and paraxial Gaussian beams.

modules.title: Lens design · 镜头设计与优化
modules.summary: 曲面、光线追迹、像差和镜头参数优化。
modules.summary_en: Trace rays, analyze aberrations and optimize lens parameters.

modules.title: Lens prescriptions · 镜头处方与成像分析
modules.summary: 读取和构建顺序光学系统，分析近轴与实际光线。
modules.summary_en: Build and inspect sequential optical prescriptions and image formation.

modules.title: Radiometry · 辐射度与非顺序光线
modules.summary: 场景、光谱、材料与探测器之间的辐射传输。
modules.summary_en: Model spectral radiation transfer between scenes and detectors.

modules.title: Scalar propagation · 标量衍射与光束传播
modules.summary: 孔径、透镜、传播与标量复振幅计算。
modules.summary_en: Propagate scalar complex fields through apertures and lenses.

modules.title: Vector diffraction · 矢量衍射与聚焦
modules.summary: 标量及矢量场传播、偏振和聚焦。
modules.summary_en: Model vector fields, polarization and diffraction-limited focusing.

modules.title: Fourier imaging · 傅里叶成像与点扩散函数
modules.summary: 瞳面、像差、衍射 PSF 与光学传播链。
modules.summary_en: Build pupil-to-image propagation chains and diffraction PSFs.

modules.title: Wavefront analysis · 波前与成像质量
modules.summary: 波前、Zernike 表示、PSF 与 MTF。
modules.summary_en: Analyze wavefronts, Zernike modes, PSFs and MTFs.

modules.title: Adaptive optics · 自适应光学
modules.summary: 湍流、波前传感、变形镜与闭环仿真。
modules.summary_en: Simulate turbulence, wavefront sensing, deformable mirrors and feedback.

modules.title: Polarization · 偏振与穆勒矩阵
modules.summary: Jones、Stokes、Mueller 计算与偏振元件建模。
modules.summary_en: Calculate Jones, Stokes and Mueller representations of polarization.

modules.title: Mutual coherence · 经典统计光学与相干性
modules.summary: 互相干矩阵、相干模与部分相干传播。
modules.summary_en: Represent mutual coherence, coherent modes and partially coherent propagation.

modules.title: Speckle statistics · 散斑与强度统计
modules.summary: 复随机场、散斑对比度、相关长度与多模平均。
modules.summary_en: Calculate speckle contrast, correlations and independent-mode averaging.

modules.title: Thin films · 多层薄膜
modules.summary: 多层膜反射、透射、吸收与场分布。
modules.summary_en: Calculate multilayer reflection, transmission, absorption and internal fields.

modules.title: Sphere scattering · 球形颗粒散射
modules.summary: Mie 散射效率、角分布与消光。
modules.summary_en: Calculate Mie scattering efficiencies and angular distributions.

modules.title: Multiple scattering · 多体散射与 T 矩阵
modules.summary: 多极展开、T 矩阵与多体散射。
modules.summary_en: Use multipole expansions and T matrices for interacting scatterers.

modules.title: Particles near layers · 层状介质中的颗粒散射
modules.summary: 结合层状背景与颗粒多重散射。
modules.summary_en: Model particle multiple scattering in layered backgrounds.

modules.title: Discrete dipoles · 离散偶极散射
modules.summary: 任意形状颗粒的离散偶极近似。
modules.summary_en: Model scattering by discretized particles of arbitrary shape with ADDA.

modules.title: FDTD · 全波时域计算
modules.summary: 结构、源、边界与电磁场时域传播。
modules.summary_en: Simulate electromagnetic fields, sources and boundaries in the time domain.

modules.title: Photonic bands · 光子晶体能带与模态
modules.summary: MPB 本征模、色散与周期结构能带。
modules.summary_en: Calculate periodic photonic eigenmodes and band dispersion with MPB.

modules.title: Periodic RCWA · 周期光栅与超表面
modules.summary: 周期层状结构的 RCWA 散射。
modules.summary_en: Calculate diffraction and scattering from periodic layered structures.

modules.title: Photonic slab modes · 光子晶体薄板模态
modules.summary: 导模展开、薄板能带与辐射损耗。
modules.summary_en: Model photonic slab modes and radiation loss by guided-mode expansion.

modules.title: Inverse electromagnetics · 电磁逆向设计
modules.summary: 可微 FDFD/FDTD 模型与结构优化。
modules.summary_en: Optimize electromagnetic structures with differentiable field models.

modules.title: Semiconductor transport · 半导体载流子与器件输运
modules.summary: Poisson、漂移扩散及自定义器件方程。
modules.summary_en: Solve Poisson, drift-diffusion and custom semiconductor device equations.

modules.title: Photovoltaic devices · 光伏与多结光电器件
modules.summary: 材料、吸收、结模型与太阳能电池光电响应。
modules.summary_en: Combine absorption and junction models for photovoltaic device response.

modules.title: Semiconductor quantum wells · 半导体量子阱与能带
modules.summary: 半导体量子阱能级、材料能带与吸收模型。
modules.summary_en: Model semiconductor quantum-well levels, band structure and absorption.

modules.title: Nonlinear fiber pulses · 光纤非线性脉冲传播
modules.summary: 色散、非线性与广义非线性薛定谔方程传播。
modules.summary_en: Propagate nonlinear optical pulses using generalized envelope models.

modules.title: Broadband pulse propagation · 宽带与超快脉冲
modules.summary: 基于解析信号的宽带非线性传播。
modules.summary_en: Simulate broadband nonlinear pulse propagation with analytic-signal models.

modules.title: Phase matching · 非线性频率转换与相位匹配
modules.summary: 波矢失配、相干长度与转换带宽的计算起点。
modules.summary_en: Calculate wave-vector mismatch, coherence length and conversion bandwidth.

modules.title: Laser rate equations · 激光速率方程
modules.summary: 载流子、光子数、增益与时间响应模型。
modules.summary_en: Model pump, inversion, photons and laser time response with rate equations.

modules.title: Optical resonators · 谐振腔与干涉仪
modules.summary: 频域光学系统、腔模、失谐与信号响应。
modules.summary_en: Model optical cavities, detuning, modes and interferometer response.

modules.title: Optical communications · 光纤通信与数字信号处理
modules.summary: 调制、光纤信道、接收和 DSP 仿真。
modules.summary_en: Simulate optical modulation, fiber channels, receivers and DSP.

modules.title: Photonic layout · 光子芯片器件与布线
modules.summary: 参数化器件、端口、互连和版图生成。
modules.summary_en: Generate parametric photonic devices, ports, routes and layouts.

modules.title: Mask geometry · 掩模与 GDS/OASIS 几何
modules.summary: 版图层、单元、几何变换与版图文件读写。
modules.summary_en: Read and construct GDS/OASIS geometry with the KLayout Python API.

modules.title: Photonic circuits · 光子集成电路仿真
modules.summary: 由器件散射矩阵组合光子电路。
modules.summary_en: Compose photonic circuits from component scattering matrices.

modules.title: Quantum trajectories · 量子轨迹与开放系统
modules.summary: Lindblad 演化与蒙特卡洛量子轨迹。
modules.summary_en: Simulate Lindblad evolution and stochastic quantum trajectories.

modules.title: Photon correlations · 光子关联与量子统计
modules.summary: 一阶与二阶关联、稳态和光子数统计。
modules.summary_en: Calculate optical correlations and photon-number statistics.

modules.title: Linear quantum photonics · 线性光学量子电路
modules.summary: 光子输入态、干涉网络与输出概率。
modules.summary_en: Simulate photon states, interferometers and measurement probabilities.

modules.title: Continuous-variable photonics · 连续变量量子光学
modules.summary: 高斯态、压缩、光学量子电路与测量。
modules.summary_en: Connect Gaussian and Fock simulation backends for optical quantum circuits.

modules.title: Digital holography · 数字全息与相位重建
modules.summary: 全息图传播、相移与相位补偿。
modules.summary_en: Reconstruct amplitude and phase from digital holograms.
